mostWorthwhile.text: The calcium-triggered pulling cycle was most worthwhile: the planned closeups connect ATP use to myosin movement and distinguish filament sliding from filament shortening.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the triceps repeated much of the biceps assembly, including the same force-path inset. It established the different three-headed arrangement, but was less engaging.

surprise.text: ATP-powered calcium pumping is needed for relaxation, not just for the pulling cycle. The result also specifies that an outside pull lengthens the relaxed fibre.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though building biceps before triceps was an arbitrary ordering choice; both were compatible options.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how these assembled structures work together, although most decisions here followed a single offered combination rather than requiring a meaningful choice.
